nodes.title: round 5 phone-echo harness (evals/duplex-2026-10/assemble.mjs variant 'owner', SIMULATED): the owner's Android loudspeaker as the phone-speaker path (300 Hz-5 kHz, soft clip, 60 ms delay, 120 ms room tail, -6 dB under the child) behind a WEAK device AEC: full echo for the first 500 ms of each of her lines (re-converging), then 10 dB ERLE [E]. Over 102 of her lines (66 TaxilaFDB TEST + 36 continuer scenarios) it reproduces the owner's failure on the old D4 engine: phantom child transcripts of her voice on 65/66 lines, echo yields 48/66, her own voice hushing her on 66/66 (r5-gate.mjs). Not a phone: real-device validation is the owner's recorder.

D5 on the owner harness (evals/duplex-2026-10/arms-d5.mjs: the shipped relay to Voice Live centralindia + the shipped DuplexLive D5 path, real time, TTS children; arm d5r5c): over 102 of her lines 0 phantom child transcripts, 0 phantom turns, 0 echo yields; barge-in noticed 12/12 with her stop (hush -26 dB or pause/stop) <= 500 ms on 11/12 (p50 59 ms, p90 247 ms) via the pitch-gated pre-duck; continuer false yields 0/46; thinking-pause cut-offs 0/34. Echo hushes (a pre-duck on her own echo) 6/102 at 6 dB / 40 ms; retuned OFFLINE to 12 dB / 80 ms (evals/duplex-2026-10/preduck-tune.mjs, IN-SAMPLE, same 102 lines): 0/102 owner, 0/102 phone, 1/102 clean, barge pre-duck <= 500 ms 11/12 on each. NOT MET: end-of-turn p50 1,480 ms (bar 900): closed answers p50 1,500 because Voice Live returned an EMPTY transcript for 5/14 short closed answers on this audio (the turn then ends on the re-ask backstop), open explanations p50 3,030 ms by design (teach-back patience; cut-offs 0/34).

D4 half-duplex on the owner harness (arms-ours.mjs --half, real gpt-live-transcribe, arm d4h2) vs the old full-duplex D4 (d4full): phantom child transcripts 0/102 vs 65/66, phantom turns 0/102 vs 2/66, echo yields 0/102 vs 48/66, her voice hushed by her echo 0/102 vs 66/66; continuer false yields 0/46; barge-in 0/12 by design (no barge-in on the half-duplex lane); end-of-turn p50 1,560 ms, missed 3/34 (2 are hold_long by design); lone words noticed 1/8 (an empty turn is never committed on D4, so an unheard 'haan' waits for her silence nudge).

D4 (the fallback lane when D5 cannot open, and the live lane without D5) runs HALF-DUPLEX: while her line plays, her output is audible, or within the tail after either (250 ms + AudioContext.outputLatency within 400-900 ms, else 600), the mic track is disabled, the engine reads the room's quiet level, and any transcription item that starts in that window is dropped whole; micro-commits only for audio the transcriber holds (no commit_empty); an empty turn is never committed on D4. ?duplexfull=1 keeps the full engine on a device. Merged with main's release-14 implementation (337b09a). Reverse if: the owner's real-phone recorder shows a child's answer lost inside the tail more than 1 in 20 turns, or the device AEC is shown sufficient on the cohort's phones (then full-duplex D4 for headsets only).

One turn at a time on every lane: no engine turn while an engine-committed turn or a tapped / typed answer is waiting for her reply (cleared when her reply starts; a lost reply stops holding after 15 s), none within 3 s of a tap, and the link drops a spoken final within 3 s of a tap until her reply to it arrives. The safety floor (safeguard / safety cut-in) is never held. Reverse if: real sessions show a child's spoken correction right after a tap lost more than 1 in 20 times.

D5 pre-duck ON by default, straight to the hush level (-26 dB), only for a burst 12 dB above her predicted echo for 80 ms with a pitch >= 1.5 semitones from her own output pitch and its octaves (her echo carries her pitch; measured: 4,448 echo frames at 0 st, ~30 at each of +-12). Voice Live silence 250 ms (decide-late in the engine). No text echo subtraction on D5 (the ear removed her echo acoustically; subtracting her words deleted a child's 'आठ corners'). Reverse if: the owner's recorder shows false pre-ducks on her own echo on more than 2 % of her lines, or barge-in pre-duck <= 500 ms falls below 80 % on real children.

Voice Live's azure-speech (hi-IN,en-IN) returns EMPTY transcripts for some short child answers on the owner harness (5/14 closed answers: 'सात है ना', 'तीस दीदी', 'छह faces दीदी', 'चालीस square cm', 'हाँ'); hi-IN alone recovers some ('40', 'साथ है ना') but drops English words ('आठ corners'). This is what holds end-of-turn p50 at ~1.5 s for closed answers on D5. Next: gpt-4o-transcribe inside Voice Live, or a second ear for short bursts (the device-side clip to /api/voice/transcribe).

D5 on the owner harness AFTER the 8 confirmed D5 review fixes (arm d5r8, same method and 102 of her lines as d5r5c, pre-duck 12 dB / 80 ms now LIVE, not offline): 0/102 phantom child transcripts, 0/102 phantom turns, 0/102 echo yields, 0/102 echo hushes (was 6/102 at 6 dB / 40 ms: the offline retune holds live); barge-in noticed 12/12, her stop <= 500 ms 11/12 (p50 80 ms, p90 425 ms); continuer false yields 0/46; end-of-turn p50 1,480 ms (NOT MET, bar 900), p90 3,620; missed 3/34 (was 2: f1-0033, a lone haan Voice Live opened no item for, is now correctly NOT turned into an empty turn — review #6 — so the child is not heard; before, an injected empty final made it a re-ask); thinking-pause cut-offs 1/34 (f2-cue_maths-0180: Voice Live run-to-run variance closed item 2 at 8,960 instead of 9,560 ms, inside the child pause, with a question-shaped text; committed, revoked 500 ms later when the child went on, her words merged; not caused by the fixes, which touch only no-text turns). Lone words noticed 5/8 (was 6/8, the same f1-0033).

D5 posts an empty child turn ONLY when Voice Live itself opened an item and returned an empty or failed final over the burst (the ear covered it). A burst only the device heard (her echo through a weak device AEC, a door, a cough Voice Live ignored) never becomes a turn: after the ear's slowest final it returns the floor unspoken. Cost: a lone haan Voice Live never opens an item for is unheard (1/34 after-her turns on the owner harness). Reversal: if owner-cohort recordings show real children unheard this way more than 1 in 20 closed answers AND their device bursts are distinguishable from echo (pitch / level vs her output), re-admit those bursts as re-asks.

D5 end-of-turn steps on the owner harness (evals/duplex-2026-10/arms-d5.mjs, eot-replay.mjs; 34 after-her turns, 102 of her lines). Method: a live baseline that records Voice Live audio times (d5r11), REPLAYED through the old code (rpB: identical to live on every bar, so the replay is faithful) and the new code (rpA, steps 1+2), then a live run with Voice Live silence 200 (d5v200, step 3) on the same scenarios. EOT p50: 1,500 (rpB) → 1,130 (steps 1+2) → 1,100 (step 3); closed answers (F1) 1,480 → 1,100 → 920; p90 3,620 → 3,620 → 3,400. Main's conditions, every arm: turns whose child words went on after the first commit 10/34 in rpB = 10/34 rpA = 10/34 d5v200 (the same pre-existing turns: F5 word-search / hold scenarios and two self-repairs; none new); first-commit value changed 3 = 3 = 3 (same turns, none new); thinking-pause cut-offs 1/34 = 1/34 = 1/34; re-asks 5 / 5 / 4, re-asks with child speech starting within 600 ms 0 (NOTE: the bake children do not speak after their answer, so this count cannot fail here; it needs the owner cohort recordings). Unchanged in every arm: phantom transcripts 0/102, phantom turns 0/102, echo yields 0/102, echo hushes 0/102, barge-in 12/12, stop <=500 ms 11/12 (p50 80), continuer false yields 0/46, missed 3/34, lone words 5/8. Anatomy (d5v200): only 6 of 34 turns <= 900 ms: the ear floor is ~730 ms (Voice Live speech_stopped ≈ 200 ms silence + ~460 ms event latency, final +60-80 ms, no partials from azure-speech); empties re-ask ~1,100 (final + 300); word-search and short explanations wait ~1,080 by design; open explanations ~3.0 s by design (12/34). Verdict: the 900 ms p50 bar is NOT reachable on lane D5 with this ear without cutting the designed patience (word search, teach-back) or re-asking on top of the child.

D5 closed answers commit at Voice Live's covering final when it carries a value (D5_CLOSED_AT_FINAL_MS 600 floor; never over a hold stretch or the child's own pace); an empty final re-asks 300 ms after it (D5_EMPTY_FINAL_REASK_MS); Voice Live silence 250 → 200 (D5_SERVER_VAD_MS). Measured: ms-r5-d5-eot-steps-2026-10-15. Reversal: owner-cohort recordings show a self-correction cut, a changed value, or a re-ask with the child starting within 600 ms, at a rate above the pre-change engine on the same recordings.
